Committee: Ways and Means Education
Sponsor: Blackshear
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 02/28/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 382 as introduced could decrease receipts to the State General Fund and the Education Trust Fund by an undetermined amount dependent on the gross proceeds of purchases of travel trailers, campers, and housecars that are exempt from the payment of the state 2% sales tax pursuant to the current drive-out provisions provided by state law.
Danny Garrett, Chair
Ways and Means Education
